how: Reviewer-recorded on DGX Spark (Linux aarch64) as the dedicated test user zylos-test with a temporary HOME, installed with the official install.sh, Gemini API key mode, AGY_CLI_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=true. Launched with --dangerously-skip-permissions --settings '{"modelProvider":"gemini","trustedWorkspaces":[<workspace>]}' in a private tmux socket, pane 200x50, after one real turn. Each screen is unmodified `tmux capture-pane -p` output; cursorX/cursorY are `display -p '#{cursor_x}'` / `'#{cursor_y}'` read immediately before the capture and re-read unchanged immediately after it.

empty.txt.description: Empty input box after a completed turn.

slash-menu.txt.description: Slash command menu opened by typing /.

panel-empty.txt.description: Empty input box with the background task panel below it (a background sleep task running).

panel-draft.txt.description: One-line draft typed with the background task panel below the input box.
